text:
Maria Chen: FYI Atlantech usage plunged ~40% last 48h, renewal in 6 weeks. looks related to a new security approval flow their infra team turned on.
Devon Lee: ugh. any signal it's an outage vs org change?
Maria Chen: not an outage. they still hit the healthcheck endpoints. token counts and session starts dropped. here's the quick query I ran:
```sql
SELECT day, sum(tokens) FROM usage_events WHERE account_id = 'acct_atlantech' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 7;
```
Ashish Patel: can you DM the exec sponsor? procurement pinged us yesterday about a cost review -> might be moving to a competitor trial.
Maria Chen: yep looped Lucy (customer advocate) and Patrick (eng handoff). Lucy, can you lead an outreach with a short checklist? we should confirm admin churn + ask for current evaluation criteria.
Lucy Ramos: on it. will do quick 15m with their new platform lead tomorrow. prep note: ask about SSO keys & any blocked endpoints, and whether they tried our dedicated trial.
Patrick O'Neill: if they request dedicated capacity trial we should propose a 2-week reserved sandbox with higher observability. I can prep config and a short runbook. :thumbsup:
Devon Lee: also flag for renewal ops — mark as "at-risk: stakeholder change" and enable proc continuity playbook.
ops-bot: Incident detection rule "usage-drop" triggered for acct_atlantech at 1723349800. Notifying: customer-success, sales.
Ashish Patel: small ask — capture their procurement timeline in the thread after call. we want to know decision owners and any competitor names.
Maria Chen: agreed. Lucy will add notes. if they mention model parity concerns, route to product for a quick feature compare doc. Thanks team.
